Run R5021 · task T1168 (Board polish round 2: the 8 lows left after the v1 board polish) · code-reviewer · project /Users/erickb336/workspace/sage

GOAL        Review PR 616 on head fa10ca39b8fef5e896b172d7edd77ecabf10897b for correctness, data safety, regressions and test evidence, and say for each of the 8 findings F-T1168-1 to -8 whether the change fixes it. This is cycle 1's code review; QA already passed on this head.
SCOPE       PR 616, branch sage/t1168-board-polish-2, read-only worktree /Users/erickb336/workspace/sage/.claude/worktrees/t1168 (at the head above). Review the diff against its merge base with main (git -C <worktree> diff origin/main...HEAD). Change no files. Scratch: your own subfolder <scratchpad>/R5021/.
CONTEXT     - The task's original brief, whose SCOPE lists the 8 findings and whose Out list applies: /Users/erickb336/.sage/sage-43265b/briefs/R4934.md (read it; it is read-only).
            - The 8 findings: F-T1168-1 pairing browser test timed out once (find the cause, fix it); -2 and -3 need-you tile counts 1 through an unread milestone need when the gates table cannot be read (board-model.mjs); -4 a checkout path with a colon breaks the merge-tree carry (state.mjs, GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES vs info/alternates); -5 an old tab still says Reconnecting, and the README overclaims; -6 Restore focus test waits a fixed 1500 ms; -7 chips, filters and tabs under 44 px at 390 px; -8 the Overview shows the read-only note twice, and the task page says chief in progress.
            - CI passed on this head (check, static, test 1-4).
            - Earlier cycles found these lows, which moved to task T1174 and are out of scope here: popover menu targets under 44 px, text-link targets under 44 px, live chief wording that differs between views, the task page scrolling sideways at 320 px. Do not report them again.
            - An earlier code review of this head (R4994) ran, but its report was lost by the old hook; this run replaces it.
DECISIONS   Touch targets are at least 44 px at phone width. Only function or safety problems are medium or high (order 34); polish is low.
ACCEPTANCE  - A verdict (CLEAN or FINDINGS) on the exact head above, with a line in EVIDENCE for each of F-T1168-1 to -8: fixed or not fixed, with the command or file line that shows it.
            - Each medium or high finding has a proof and a saw line (the report skill).
VERIFY      Run only the test files for the changed code, each file alone (order 31), plus order 63's list for the state.mjs change. Use HOME and SAGE_HOME in your scratch subfolder, with a fake ps and a fake kill first on PATH. Browser: order 84.
BUDGET      About 45 min agent time, 300k tokens.
FORBIDDEN   No file changes, no commits, no push, no merge. Never run the state tool. Never use port 4173 or 43123, never run the board CLI on its default port, never use Claude's browser pane or Claude in Chrome. Never run real ps, pgrep, kill or launchctl. Never read under ~/.config/sage-board or Claude's memory folders. No T1174 work.
REPORT      The report of the sage:report skill, RESULT starting CLEAN or FINDINGS. End your run with one final message whose plain text is the full report, also after any SubagentHandback call.
STANDING    The standing orders apply in full: read them with node /Users/erickb336/.claude/plugins/cache/sage/sage/8287051932dc/skills/sage/sage.mjs standing --project /Users/erickb336/workspace/sage before you start, and put the same pointer in every helper brief. Order 85 is now met (T1175 is installed), but still end with a plain-text final report.

STATUS        done
RESULT        CLEAN. On head fa10ca39, PR 616 fixes F-T1168-2 to -8. F-T1168-1 is closed with a found root cause that PR 590 (already on main) fixed, so this PR needs no code for it. I found no correctness, data or regression problems.
EVIDENCE
- I read the standing orders, the brief /Users/erickb336/.sage/sage-43265b/briefs/R4934.md, the PR 616 description (`gh pr view 616`, headRefOid fa10ca39b8fef5e896b172d7edd77ecabf10897b), and `git diff origin/main...HEAD` (29 files, 9 commits). The review worktree has no changes (`git status --short` printed nothing).
- Setup: HOME and SAGE_HOME in my scratch folder (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-erickb336-workspace-sage/d05e730b-da8f-455e-8e7e-fb034cf9f9b4/scratchpad/R5021/). Fake ps, kill, pgrep and launchctl were first on PATH. I proved each fake by spawning it from node with no shell: it printed FAKE-PS, FAKE-KILL -0 999999, FAKE-PGREP and FAKE-LAUNCHCTL.
- F-T1168-1 fixed, through PR 590 and not through this PR:
  - The one timeout was F-T1125-9, in local QA run R4508 on head 068be76: "Run 1 failed 1 test of 18 ... F-T1125-9, with a 30 s timeout".
  - `git merge-base --is-ancestor 66b9e9f9 068be76` exited 1, so head 068be76 does not have PR 590. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 231f24b2 068be76` exited 0, so it has PR 587.
  - PR 590 (66b9e9f9) moves the pairing note to useSyncExternalStore. The R4540 report shows that the old code failed the same wait 3 of 3 times. PR 590 is in this head (the `--is-ancestor` check printed 590-in-head).
  - `node --test scripts/board-writes-browser.test.mjs` on the head: 20 pass, 0 fail.
- F-T1168-2 and -3 fixed (packages/sage-core/board-model.mjs:393):
  - "unread" is now in PROBLEM_NEEDS. Its only user is `problems` (line 761), which board-stats.mjs:26 subtracts from needsOwner. So Stats drops the need, and the Overview's needsOwner and its problem row stay the same.
  - On base f0951283 with the new test, the test failed with `actual: { needs: 1, kinds: [ 'unread', 'logbook' ] }` against expected `needs: 0`. On the head, board-stats.test.mjs passed 11 of 11.
- F-T1168-4 fixed (packages/sage-core/local-git.mjs:29):
  - GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES is now one C-quoted entry, with `\` and `"` escaped. Its only caller is state.mjs:2018, which passes one path.
  - On base f0951283 with the new test, the test failed: "... merges 12a9908d... with a conflict". On the head, merge-carry.test.mjs passed 13 of 13, with a path that has a colon, a quote and a backslash.
- F-T1168-5 fixed by making the text true (packages/sage-board/README.md:140): the README now says that an old tab still says "Reconnecting", and why. `git grep Reconnecting` outside plugins finds no other claim. board-server.test.mjs passed 27 of 27.
- F-T1168-6 fixed (scripts/board-archive-browser.test.mjs:369): the fixed 1500 ms wait is now a waitForFunction on the focused "harbor is restored." note. board-archive-browser.test.mjs passed 9 of 9.
- F-T1168-7 fixed (board.css:578-580): 44 px min-height, plus a new test that measures every control on the Overview, Tasks and a task page at 390 px. board-narrow-browser.test.mjs passed 6 of 6, with the new tests F-T1168-7 and "F-T1159-50 in CI".
  - The `grid-template-rows: auto 1fr` fix is safe because `.app` has two children only (app.jsx:164-210: aside and .col).
- F-T1168-8 fixed:
  - actions.jsx:92 has one read-only note. overview.jsx:132 gives no pairing hint when writes is "off"; useAccess returns only off, paired or unpaired.
  - task.jsx:13 defines CHIEF_FACT, so the facts line says "chief active", "chief stopped" or "chief state unknown".
  - board-app-browser passed 20 of 20, board-task-page-browser 8 of 8 and board-tasks-browser 36 of 36.
- Order 63's list, each file alone, all pass: shared-root 192/192, chiefs 177/177, board-shared 45/45, sage-hook-1 to -4 70/70 each, sage-hook-5 69/69, sage-hook-6 69/69.
- Fragile patterns: none. The change adds no hook rule, no rule written twice and no shell-command parsing. The F-4 quoting is the general Git escape, not a special case.
- Cleanup: I removed my scratch worktree at f0951283 with `git worktree remove`.
FINDINGS      none
QUESTIONS     none
NOT VERIFIED
- I did not run the new browser tests of F-T1168-7 and -8 against the base. The base worktree in scratch had no node_modules, and installing them was outside this review. The PR's table says that they fail on main.
- I took no screenshots, because QA already passed on this head with the 390 px screenshots.
- I did not reread the CI logs; the brief says CI passed on this head.
- The old tab's "Reconnecting" line comes from the browser's EventSource. I checked it through the README text and the server test, not in a real old tab.
BRANCH        sage/t1168-board-polish-2 head fa10ca39b8fef5e896b172d7edd77ecabf10897b https://github.com/erickb336/sage-stack/pull/616
